snippet.title: Ashore & Away - Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Ashore & Away is a vibrant open-world adventure that throws you into the unpredictable heart of the Bermuda Triangle.
*Wishlist now on Steam* : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3838200/Ashore__Away/

Uncover a rich mystery and storyline. How and when you engage with it is completely up to you. Sail in any direction, tackle challenges in any order, and discover your own unique way home.

In the end, the choice is yours; play at your own pace and explore however you like.  Stay Ashore or sail Away and venture out into the unknown! Ultimately, your escape depends on your wits, your raft, and the hidden knowledge of the islands.

How will you make your way back home?
